with_yev.speaker: yev
with_yev.text: Here. A growing-frame, Rootched work, and inside it my grove, taught to grow around a shard of the Loom. They are growing a Key. Out of my grove.

choices.text: Take a cutting home. The Garden can hold it.
Leave it. Let us see what a Key grows into.

burned.speaker: yev
burned.text: Thank you. I could not have. I would have talked to it.

saved.speaker: yev
saved.text: It will grow in your Garden. Slowly. The grove taught it slowly.

left.speaker: yev
left.text: Then we will come back, and it will have grown, and we will see whose it is.

alone.speaker: player
alone.text: A Rootched growing-frame, and in it something green wound round something that is not.

dead.speaker: player
dead.text: Yev's grove, in a frame, growing without her. You take one cutting, for the pot on her bunk.
